description: Authoritative writer/owner registry for every table in ops.* schema. Lints against architecture/schema-snapshot.json. See architecture/README.md.

writers.name: sync-qbo
writers.notes: Legacy QBO sync. Writes qbo_token_cache via lease RPC ops.qbo_token_claim_refresh().

writers.name: sync-qbo-items
writers.schedule: nightly 09:30 UTC + on-demand from Margin UI
writers.notes: Populates purchase_cost which powers est_cost / est_margin in v_sales_lines. Uses lease RPC for token refresh. Cron defined in 20260503r_nightly_sync_crons.sql.

writers.name: sync-qbo-expenses
external_inputs: QuickBooks Online API: Purchase / Bill / VendorCredit

writers.name: sync-qbo-employees
writers.notes: Lives in apbg-ops repo per its CLAUDE.md / README updates 2026-05-05. Uses the same lease RPC.

writers.name: sync-sf
writers.notes: Pulls SF jobs into ops tables. Joint doc claims this writes; source not in either repo.

writers.name: sf-oauth-callback
writers.notes: OAuth redirect target for Service Fusion auth flow.

writers.name: stale-invoice-alert
writers.notes: Read-only: scans delivery_stops / service_jobs / reman_jobs for SF $$ with no QBO match >5 days, emails Sky.

writers.name: digest-email
writers.notes: Reads digest_subscriptions to decide which subs are due. Defined in 20260503m_digest_email.sql.

writers.name: push-qbo-budget
writers.notes: Reads sales_plans and pushes a budget to QBO. Defined in 20260503v_push_qbo_budget_function.sql.

writers.name: health-alert
writers.notes: Reads sync_log + qbo_token_diagnostics; emails Sky on sync_health red/yellow.

writers.name: fn_take_health_snapshot
writers.notes: Postgres function called by pg_cron. Defined in 20260503s_health_snapshots_plan_alerts.sql.

writers.name: manual-ui:margin-minder-settings
writers.notes: Margin Minder dashboard settings UI writes via fn_set_* RPCs and direct table inserts. Authenticated only.

writers.name: manual-ui:apbg-ops-roster
writers.notes: Apbg-ops Staff Roster page writes via gateway-issued JWT against permissive policies.

writers.name: all-sync-functions:sync-log-append
writers.notes: Every sync function appends a row to ops.sync_log on completion. No single owner; this is a logging convention.
